name: cloude/framework
description: Minimalist PHP 8.4+ micro-framework: router, input, views, markdown and string helpers. No magic, no service container. Optional persistence: file-based (JSON, Markdown) and a thin PDO Active Record via Cloude\Model.

suggest.ext-intl: Required for accent-aware Cloude\Str::slug() / ascii(). Without it, non-ASCII characters are dropped instead of transliterated.
